name: Wanbury Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1988, Wanbury Ltd is in the business of pharmaceutical and related activities, including research[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
WL is a pharmaceutical company with a presence in the API global market and domestic branded Formulation. It’s majorly into Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) Sales & Marketing in over 50 countries and Pan-India 
 Formulation presence

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 30.9% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Stock is trading at 13.0 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 10.3% over past five years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 71.7% of their holding.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
